project.driver_source:
def main():
    import json
    from agentfem import project
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--until", type=float, default=1.)
    parser.add_argument("--restart", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    run = project.current_run(project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
    step = make_step(cells=4, increments=8, penalty=40000., affine_end_face_support=True)
    if args.restart:
        step.load_checkpoint(args.restart)
    if args.until == 1.:
        result = step.solve_result()
    else:
        solution = step.solve(until=args.until)
        result = results.from_solution(solution, name="accepted_partial")
        result.status = "partial"
    step.save_checkpoint(run.artifact("checkpoint.npz"))
    with results.UnifiedXDMFTimeSeries(run.artifact("results.xdmf")) as writer:
        for snapshot in step.snapshots:
            writer.write_fields(snapshot.load_factor, snapshot.solution)
    results.export_accepted_contact_points(
        step, run.artifact("contact"), result=result, vtk_view=True,
        units={"length": "m", "pressure": "Pa", "force": "N"},
    )
    work = step.accepted_history_recorders["normal_contact_work:interior_plane"]
    np.savez(run.artifact("accepted-state.npz"),
             displacement=step.solution.x.array,
             material=step.response.state.committed_state_vectors(),
             contact_force=step.contact_provider.evaluate().contact_force_on_structure,
             load_factors=np.array([i.load_factor for i in step.accepted_increments]),
             contact_work=np.array([r["work"] for r in work.records]))
    run.artifact("acceptance.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "accepted_through": step.accepted_load_factor,
        "snapshot_coordinates": [s.load_factor for s in step.snapshots],
        "periodic_mismatch": step.constraint.mismatch(step.accepted_load_factor),
        "restart": None if args.restart is None else str(args.restart),
        "claim": "bounded serial installed workflow; no spatial accuracy or full energy claim",
    }, indent=2))
    run.publish(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
